in_english.name: Krescencja
in_english.meaning: Christian name derived from Crescenzio, a saint martyr, with meaning of growth and increase of faith
in_english.long_meaning: The Christian name Krescencja is derived from Crescenzio, a saint martyr, who firmly held his faith in martyrdom and donated his life for Christ. Crescenzio, the martyr, was born in Northern Africa and obtained martyrdom during the persecution of Diocletian. The name Krescencja spread in Eastern Europe in the Middle Ages to signify Christians. It is a name that symbolizes growth and increase of faith in the Christian tradition

data.cultural_impact: The name Krescencja is of Latin origin and was popular among Slavic Christians, particularly in Central Europe. In the Middle Ages, it was considered an esteemed name, associated with noble and virtuous traits. In Poland, for example, Saint Krescencja of Tuscania, who was born in the 4th century in Italy and was a martyr, is revered as the patron saint of bakers, handicraftsmen, and goldsmiths, among others.
